findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Realign the leaf's capability-stamp unit to the parent: frame the ensure unit as a convergence BACKSTOP (not 'the single authoritative stamp'), acknowledge that the `bridge projects` set/remove write path is the authoritative synchronous stamp that lands the stamp and mapping mutation in ONE tracker commit, and drop the 'No sibling owns a write-time stamp' claim — or narrow this leaf to the seed unit only and let the store-compat-stamp sibling own the stamp.
evidence: Leaf: 'No sibling owns a write-time stamp (7032 only *documents* the token), so this ensure unit is the single authoritative stamp: a multi-project store cannot be left unstamped because the next init/`fsck`/MCP-boot sweep converges it.'

Parent 0e68 child decomposition: 'the `bridge projects` set/remove write path writes the re-derived stamp and the mapping mutation in the SAME tracker commit (one atomic publish ... a crash before the commit leaves neither write). Ensure sweeps are convergence backstops for any residual divergence, not the trigger.'

Parent 0e68 AC: 'A store whose mapping holds more than one project carries multi-project-bridge ... including that the stamp and mapping mutation land in one tracker commit (asserted on the commit's tree).'

Leaf stamps on a LATER, separate sweep ('it fires on a later sweep once an operator added a second project'), which cannot produce the single-commit atomicity the parent AC requires, and the leaf's testing only asserts the two-project stamp value — not the one-commit tree property.
findings.finding: The leaf redefines the multi-project capability stamp as 'the single authoritative stamp' delivered by its own ensure unit, contradicting the parent epic's design that assigns the authoritative stamp to the `bridge projects` set/remove write path (atomic single tracker commit) and demotes ensure sweeps to 'convergence backstops... not the trigger'.
findings.location: Approach § unit 2 ('Stamp the capability (idempotent convergence)'); parent 0e68 child-decomposition 'The store-compat capability stamp' + final AC (one tracker commit)
scenarios: A binary makes a store multi-project via `bridge projects set`; under the parent's design the stamp lands in the same commit as the mapping mutation, but the leaf leaves the store transiently unstamped until a later ensure sweep, opening the window the parent's atomic-publish design closes.
The epic acceptance test asserts the stamp+mapping land in one tracker commit on the commit tree; a store made multi-project through the leaf's ensure-only stamp path would fail that assertion.
findings.suggested_fix: Reword unit 2 to: 'Backstop convergence only — the authoritative stamp is the synchronous atomic single-commit stamp written by the `bridge projects` set/remove write path (owned by the store-compat capability stamp child); this ensure unit re-derives and re-stamps only to converge any residual divergence a sweep observes.' Remove the 'single authoritative stamp' / 'no sibling owns a write-time stamp' language, and either defer the atomic-commit AC to the stamp sibling or state that this leaf does not claim it.
